target.statement: Ours achieves 34.21 dB PSNR / 0.969 SSIM on GoPro (Table 1), demonstrating the benefit of the kernel-prior Frequency Integration Module for blind image deblurring.

compute.basis: The target is a full GoPro-trained deblurring result requiring the unreleased implementation plus three-stage training on 8 NVIDIA V100 GPUs (400k kernel-estimator iterations, backbone/FIM training, and 200k fine-tuning iterations), which is weeks on a CPU-only laptop even with reduced settings.

blockers: No source code or pretrained model released; paper only says source code will be available soon
Training target requires 8 NVIDIA V100 GPUs and a multi-stage schedule totaling hundreds of thousands of iterations
GoPro/HIDE/RealBlur training and evaluation data are several GB and not practical to train on CPU within hours
The headline result also depends on reimplementing or retraining the FFTFormer backbone and the kernel-estimation module
title: Frequency-domain Learning with Kernel Prior for Blind Image Deblurring
